items.title: Lester Santiago Interview, 1959-01-09
items.q: Eddie Vincent was from across the ground, but that was...

ctx.x: Died recently… Died recently… Died recently… Was that saxophone or clarinet? No clarinet. We had Big Eye Lowry on clarinet.
That was Nelson. Eddie Vincent was from across the ground, but that was...
He died years ago in Chicago. Yeah, I know this one.
